stage: recovered MVP foundation, build green, manual deploy ready
target_users: health-conscious adults seeking more natural daily rhythm
people improving sleep, sunlight, movement, food, hydration, stress, nature exposure, and connection
early adopters of ancestral-health and human-alignment products
core_problem: Modern life pulls people away from the biological rhythms and inputs humans are designed for, creating low energy, poor sleep, stress, disconnection, and inconsistent habits.
core_solution: Ayncient gives users a premium alignment system with an onboarding quiz, reset protocol, dashboard, daily check-ins, protocols, and journaling to help them return to human-compatible rhythm.
product_flows: visitor reads homepage and joins waitlist
visitor takes alignment quiz and saves result
user opens dashboard and records daily check-in
user reviews protocols and writes journal entries

design_system.visual_language: grounded dark surfaces, warm off-white text, muted gold accents, plant-toned secondary colors
avoid: loud synthetic gradients as the core brand

do_not_rules: Do not turn Ayncient into generic SaaS.
Do not expose internal Autobuilder automation publicly.
Do not use the public Supabase schema.
Do not use npm or package-lock.json.
Do not delete source code during recovery.
Do not remove quiz, dashboard, protocols, reset, journal, or waitlist.
cleanup_policy: Keep node_modules, .next, dist, build, coverage, reports, cache folders, logs, and local env files out of git.
Preserve displaced source under .autobuilder/legacy-* when route conflicts require moving it out of the Next app tree.
Use pnpm install and pnpm build for validation.
